title: 조삼모사 ① 커피 한 잔 vs 태블릿 — 가전 매장 · 카페 · 계산기 · 원숭이

cast.monkey: the acorn monkey: a small cartoon brown monkey with big round ears, a cream-colored face and belly, narrow squinting eyes like a deadpan accountant, a long curly tail; NO text, NO logos

items.title: 배경 — 가전 매장 진열대 (태블릿 코너)
items.desc: The tablet corner of a bright Korean electronics store seen straight-on like a sitcom set: a long clean white display table with several slim tablets standing on stands, one big empty white price-tag card on a stand in the middle foreground, shelves of gadgets behind, bright store lighting. No people. Every screen and price card is completely blank; no writing anywhere.

items.title: 배경 — 카페 카운터
items.desc: A cozy modern Korean cafe counter seen straight-on like a sitcom set: a wooden counter with an espresso machine, a cash register with a blank screen, a glass pastry case, a chalkboard menu left completely blank, warm pendant lights. No people, no hands. No writing anywhere.

items.title: 소품 — 신형 태블릿 (브랜드 없음)
items.desc: A slim modern tablet computer standing slightly angled, thin silver body, big blank glowing blue-white screen with no icons and no writing, no logo on the back or anywhere.

items.title: 소품 — 아이스 아메리카노
items.desc: A clear plastic takeaway cup of iced americano with ice cubes, a black straw and a plain brown cup sleeve, condensation drops on the cup. No logo, no writing.

items.title: 소품 — 계산기
items.desc: A chunky cartoon pocket calculator seen slightly from above, big rounded buttons all left blank, and a wide empty gray display with no digits and no writing.

items.title: 소품 — 도토리
items.desc: One shiny round brown acorn with a textured light-brown cap, a tiny stem, a glossy highlight.

items.title: 원숭이 — 기본 (실눈, 도토리 한 알)
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Standing upright like a serious accountant, one hand holding a single acorn up between two fingers, the other hand on his hip, narrow deadpan squinting eyes, mouth a small flat line.

items.title: 원숭이 — 도토리 세기 (양손에 셋 · 넷)
items.desc: 3/4 view turned slightly to the LEFT. Holding three acorns in his left hand and four acorns in his right hand, held out to both sides like a balance scale, eyes half-closed and calm, a tiny satisfied smirk.
